$comment: Era base for the 2012-2018 DTM (New DTM, 4.0 V8: Audi A5/RS 5, BMW M3/M4, Mercedes C-Coupe). Every season in seasons/ with "base": "dtm-era4" builds on it (tools/layers.py): rules, tyres, damage, traced tracks, maker and tyre art, and one private sound overlay for all of them.
title: DTM 2012-2018 (era base)

audio.$comment: Engine sounds (tools/engine_audio; the audio stays out of git), shared by every season on this base. recording_years: only recordings of these years' cars are used (the 2012-2013 Audi RS 5, BMW M3 and Mercedes C-Coupe). research_season: the entry list that tells which driver drove which make in the videos. key_prefix: start of the clip keys in the game's sound manifests.
